channel_collection_boundary_note: Office-curated channel homes, playlists, showcases, and collection pages are treated as arrangement surfaces rather than automatic proof that every included recording remains the current controlling answer.
channel_collection_surface_label: Example platform channel home, playlist, and collection-page posture for official voter-information media routes
current_help_recovery_note: When a voter lands on an official collection surface, the route still points back to the current official page, notice, FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of pretending that grouped media alone fully controls.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews office-curated channel homes, featured-video slots, playlists, showcases, and collection pages so grouped official recordings remain subordinate to the current written/help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow FAQ, router, or current-answer map.
featured_order_note: If featured placement, quick-access appearance, or collection order can alter what looks like the first official answer, the service records which featured and ordering state was actually reviewed.
portability_note: If the collection can be shared, favorited, alerted on, or embedded elsewhere, those collection-level affordances are treated as neighboring layers rather than as proof that the collection itself is a complete current answer map.

reviewed_collection_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the official channel home, trailer, or featured-video slot highlights the safest current starting point and preserves recovery to the current written help lane.
Reviewed whether playlist or series ordering, titles, and descriptions overclaim currentness or compress recordings with different time semantics into one seemingly current answer path.
Reviewed whether collection-level sorting, card details, and presentation settings make the grouped recordings feel like a complete stand-alone router rather than a subordinate media shelf.
Reviewed whether shared or embedded collection variants still preserve practical recovery to the current official page or named help route.

scope_mixing_note: Where evergreen, archival, and election-cycle recordings coexist in one collection, the route points back to the current official page or reviewed FAQ/help entry before action-changing reliance.
